meaning:
§ Marah = "bitter"
the spring with bitter water which was 3 days travel from the crossing place of the Red Sea in the peninsula of Sinai

elsewhere.note: When they came to Marah, they couldn’t drink from the waters of Marah, for they were bitter. Therefore its name was called Marah.
They traveled from before Hahiroth, and crossed through the middle of the sea into the wilderness. They went three days’ journey in the wilderness of Etham…
